Sara (Partnerships): Hey team, CloudRetail asked for a small hands-on cookoff next week to validate our refkit + Terraform modules for their marketplace listing. Can we scope a minimal playbook?
Alex J: +1. Suggested objectives: 1) deploy refarch with dedicated networking, 2) run smoke load, 3) publish marketplace manifest draft. Keep it <90m.
Mike (Runtime): Sounds good. We need to be explicit about model variants + quantization profiles in the refkit. I can add a `model-variants.md` snippet.
Carla (Eng-Infra): We should pick a single region + instance SKU to avoid variable perf. Recommend eu-west-1 + g5.2x for the cookoff to match partner infra.
Sara (Partnerships): OK eu-west-1 + g5.2x. Alex can you own the Terraform module checklist?
Alex J: Yep. I'll ensure modules include: provider pin (>= 4.50), module inputs for vpc/subnet IDs, kms_key_arn, and a `marketplace_manifest.json.tpl`. Will also add outputs: service_endpoint, lb_dns.
Mike (Runtime): Two quick asks: 1) ensure our runtime helmchart values allow `kv_cache_size` override; 2) include `--enable-prefetch` flag in example service args.
Alex J: Noted. I'll add these to `modules/README.md` example:```hcl
module "redwood_refkit" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@github.com/redwood/refkit-modules//marketplace"
  region = "eu-west-1"
  instance_type = "g5.2x"
  kms_key_arn = var.kms_key
  enable_prefetch = true
}
```
Carla (Eng-Infra): For the CI job, let's have a smoke test that checks token latency < 150ms p50 and successful stream start. I can add a `smoke.yml` that runs post-apply.
Sara (Partnerships): Timeline? Cookoff scheduled Tue 10:00 UTC. Prep work: Alex - terraform checklist + manifest template by Mon EOD. Mike - runtime snippet and `model-variants.md` by Mon EOD. Carla - CI smoke job + region infra notes by Mon EOD. I'll draft the partner-facing invite and runbook.
Alex J: Will also include quick rollback plan (switch to smaller model variant + autoscale to 0 if errors).
Mike (Runtime): I'll surface a note about quantization caveats for their ARM instances in the runbook.
DeployBot: Deployment pipeline triggered by @Carla (Eng-Infra) for branch `partner/refkit-cloudretail` — status: queued.
Sara (Partnerships): Awesome. One more: marketing wants a blurb for the joint announcement if the cookoff goes well. I'll loop in comms after Monday. :tada:
Alex J: 👍 I'll post the draft manifest in this thread when ready.
Carla (Eng-Infra): If anyone needs access to CloudRetail sandbox, ping me and I'll open a project invite.
Sara (Partnerships): Thanks team — short sync Tue 09:15 before the cookoff? 15m stand to go over checklist.
Mike (Runtime): Works for me.
Alex J: Works.
Carla (Eng-Infra): Works.
Sara (Partnerships): Closing notes: keep logs verbose level=debug for cookoff only, then revert. Document anything weird in the thread.
